title: The Super Silly Fiesta
hook: 大红鸡的「超级傻派对」要开始了，Dora 和 Boots 一路猜声音、唱歌、做鬼脸赶过去。

cells.en: “I can't wait to see!” Dora has an invitation to the Super Silly Fiesta.
cells.cn: “我迫不及待想去看啦！”Dora 收到了「超级傻派对」的请帖。

cells.en: Map shows the boat, the gate, and the hill with the fiesta on top.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先坐小船，再过大黄门，最后爬上开派对的小山。

cells.en: “Row? Is that right?” Dora and Boots paddle down the river.
cells.cn: “划船？这样对吗？”Dora 和 Boots 一起顺着河划下去。

cells.en: “Will you help us figure out the animals' sounds?” Moo! Oink!
cells.cn: “你能帮我们听出这些动物的叫声吗？”哞——！哼——！

cells.en: “We need to sing it the right way!” The gate only opens for a song.
cells.cn: “我们得唱对才行！”这扇门只听对了歌才打开。

cells.en: Look up! Silly animals hide in the tree. “Let's keep looking.”
cells.cn: 抬头看！傻乎乎的动物们躲在树上：“我们继续找吧。”

cells.en: “Can you make a super silly face?” Everyone laughs out loud.
cells.cn: “你能做一个超傻的鬼脸吗？”大家都哈哈大笑。

cells.en: The Big Red Chicken brings out a giant cake with candles on top.
cells.cn: 大红鸡端出一个大蛋糕，上面插着蜡烛。

cells.en: “We did it!” Everyone dances at the Super Silly Fiesta. What a day!
cells.cn: “我们做到啦！”大家在超级傻派对上跳舞，真是开心的一天！

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Super Silly Fiesta”.
ending: In the end, Dora and Boots get to the Super Silly Fiesta and dance with the Big Red Chicken. My favorite part is ______.
